claim.claim-text: 1. An operation method of user equipment (UE), comprising starting, by a UE which supports a store and forward (S&F) satellite operation, a first timer; stopping the first timer if the UE performs a procedure with a cell which is not a S&F satellite cell; receiving at least one message of a service accept message, a service reject message or a detach request message, wherein the at least one message includes a S&F satellite operation parameter, wherein the S&F satellite operation parameter incudes a store and forward monitoring list indication (SFMLI) field; and if the SFMLI field is set to “S&F monitoring list not present and delete any previously received S&F monitoring list”, deleting any previously received S&F monitoring list value for a current public land mobile network (PLMN).

2. The method of claim 1, further comprising: if the SFMLI field is set to “S&F monitoring list present”, deleting any previously stored value for a S&F monitoring list of the current PLMN and storing a value of the S&F monitoring list for the current PLMN.

3. The method of claim 1, wherein the S&F satellite cell is a cell with satellite Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN) access technology where the cell broadcasts an indication that a base station is operating in S&F mode.
4. The method of claim 1, wherein the S&F monitoring list includes a list of satellite identifiers (IDs) for one or more satellites that belong to a same PLMN.

5. The method of claim 1, wherein the S&F monitoring list indicates one or more satellites operating in a S&F mode where the UE attempts or reattempts a non-access stratum (NAS) procedure or receives mobile terminated (MT) data.

6. A user equipment (UE), the UE comprising: at least one processor; and at least one computer memory operably connectable to the at least one processor and storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, perform operations comprising: starting, by a UE which supports a store and forward (S&F) satellite operation, a first timer; stopping the first timer if the UE performs a procedure with a cell which is not a S&F satellite cell; receiving at least one message of a service accept message, a service reject message or a detach request message, wherein the at least one message includes a S&F satellite operation parameter, wherein the S&F satellite operation parameter incudes a store and forward monitoring list indication (SFMLI) field; and if the SFMLI field is set to “S&F monitoring list not present and delete any previously received S&F monitoring list”, deleting any previously received S&F monitoring list value for a current public land mobile network (PLMN).

7. The UE of claim 6, wherein the operations further comprise: if the SFMLI field is set to “S&F monitoring list present”, deleting any previously stored value for a S&F monitoring list of the current PLMN and storing a value of the S&F monitoring list for the current PLMN.

8. The UE of claim 6, wherein the S&F satellite cell is a cell with satellite Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN) access technology where the cell broadcasts an indication that a base station is operating in S&F mode.
9. The UE of claim 6, wherein the S&F monitoring list includes a list of satellite identifiers (IDs) for one or more satellites that belong to a same PLMN.

10. The UE of claim 6, wherein the S&F monitoring list indicates one or more satellites operating in a S&F mode where the UE attempts or reattempts a non-access stratum (NAS) procedure or receives mobile terminated (MT) data.

11. A semiconductor chipset, comprising: at least one processor; and at least one memory capable of storing instructions and being connected electrically to the at least one processor operably, wherein operations, performed when the instructions are executed by the at least one processor, includes: starting, by a UE which supports a store and forward (S&F) satellite operation, a first timer; stopping the first timer if the UE performs a procedure with a cell which is not a S&F satellite cell; receiving at least one message of a service accept message, a service reject message or a detach request message, wherein the at least one message includes a S&F satellite operation parameter, wherein the S&F satellite operation parameter incudes a store and forward monitoring list indication (SFMLI) field; and if the SFMLI field is set to “S&F monitoring list not present and delete any previously received S&F monitoring list”, deleting any previously received S&F monitoring list value for a current public land mobile network (PLMN).

12. The semiconductor chipset of claim 11, wherein the operations further comprise: if the SFMLI field is set to “S&F monitoring list present”, deleting any previously stored value for a S&F monitoring list of the current PLMN and storing a value of the S&F monitoring list for the current PLMN.

13. The semiconductor chipset of claim 11, wherein the S&F satellite cell is a cell with satellite Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN) access technology where the cell broadcasts an indication that a base station is operating in S&F mode.
14. The semiconductor chipset of claim 11, wherein the S&F monitoring list includes a list of satellite identifiers (IDs) for one or more satellites that belong to a same PLMN.

15. The semiconductor chipset of claim 11, wherein the S&F monitoring list indicates one or more satellites operating in a S&F mode where the UE attempts or reattempts a non-access stratum (NAS) procedure or receives mobile terminated (MT) data.
